summary: The simplified unsupported-resume design, production model-only checkpoint path and legacy no-RMS v1 path pass, but the hybrid API gate can be bypassed by drift in its unbound derived group list.

blockers.finding: state_dict/load_state_dict decide whether the optimizer is hybrid from mutable replicated_rmsprop_groups, but _validate_live_plan does not bind that list. Clearing it allows a hybrid adapter to invoke raw_state_dict and emit v1, or invoke raw_load_state_dict with a v1-shaped payload.
blockers.required_correction: Base the unsupported hybrid API gate on the immutable authenticated replicated-RMSProp schema (or bind the derived list in the live identity) so drift cannot turn the gate off. Both APIs must retain the exact unsupported error and invoke no raw method for every hybrid instance.
